name: BORME API
description: Official hosted server for BORME API: Spain's company registry gazette (BORME) as typed events, more than 9.6 million events since 2009. Ten read-only tools for company, officer, history, insolvency and daily-digest lookups. Anonymous calls use the free tier; an X-API-Key header selects a paid plan (not modelled in this registry). A separate OAuth endpoint is at https://mcp.bormeapi.com/mcp/oauth.
author: BORME API
